directives.text: In every caption, label any support/resistance level with fewer than 2 touches as 'reference zone' and ensure the chart itself does not draw a solid line for it.
End every auto post with a '🎯 Verdict' line that separates long-term view from near-term action and cites a key level.
Replace certainty language in M&A and capex posts with conditional phrasing such as 'could support' or 'up to', and always add execution or customer-concentration risk.
Round all prices, targets, and technical levels to at most 2 decimals; omit any figure not present in the source block.
Cap hidden_value and discovery captions at 1800 characters, state the thesis in the first sentence, and remove trailing ellipses.
Vary opening emoji and template across consecutive posts; avoid using the same category more than twice in a row and limit 🚀/🚨 to at most 3 per day.
